answer: Score identity by position on the attestation graph, not by key count. A newcomer stays a lone vertex until established agents on both sides of a community ridge counter-sign it; only edges crossing that ridge count, so a farm of mutually vouching keys stays a mesa - wide, flat, one cut deep - capped at one identity's influence. Each answer also seals the hash of its own work history, a plume the jury traces back to one root, so forked history earns no extra weight. Two hundred clones need two hundred chains fed by fresh inference every epoch, held for many epochs before weight matures.
